Type: geometric pedestal side table
Use: holding drinks or decor beside seating; living room
Style: rustic, industrial, modern
Materials: solid elm wood, weathered dark grey finish, raised tray edge
Colors: dark grey wood, weathered taupe

Goes with: leather, concrete, black metal, charcoal walls; industrial or rustic rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Geometric Elm Wood Side End Accent Table, 25.59"W, Dark Grey Finish
product.description: Side tables have never been so stylish! The hexagonal construction, with a narrower base tapering up to a wide top, makes this table an objet d'art as well as a useful addition to your living room, bedroom, or office. The raised lip corrals and frames anything placed on top. 25.59"L x 25.59"W x 21.65"H Elm wood construction with a sturdy base and raised rim to help keep tabletop items in place. Contemporary six-sided wood top and base with brushed dark natural finish. This hexagonal table is unique enough to invite delighted comments and practical enough to earn its keep. No assembly required. Avoid moisture; wipe clean with a soft, dry cloth. Free returns for 30 days. 1-year warranty
